The tendency and role suited to <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>, different
for each <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>. You could call it the {{medabot}}'s
"personality".

There are 6 styles: <c:ffff00>{{power_style}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{speed}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{hunter}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{sniper}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{guard}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{assist}}<c>.
Each differs in the <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> that rise and in the
{{condition_rotation}} for filling the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c>.
